0.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_000_001
0.description: Hello, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>! <hex:022B22FF2002281CFF17547269706C655472696164436F6D7065746974696F6EE803010303> is currently underway! Place in the top three, and you'll take home <hex:02310CFF054974656D02E802020203>!

1.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_000_002
1.description: Hello, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>! Looking to enter a Triple Triad tournament? I...oh. I'm afraid our records show that you've yet to take the required tutorial.
1.translation_description: Ciao, <hex:020817E905FF0A7369676E6F72696E61FF087369676E6F726503>! Vuoi iscriverti a un torneo di Triple Triad? Ah... temo che dai nostri registri risulti che non hai ancora completato il tutorial richiesto.

2.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_000_003
2.description: If you'd like to participate in tournaments, please speak with the Triple Triad master and she will gladly walk you through the basic rules of the game!
2.translation_description: Se vuoi partecipare ai tornei, parla con la maestra di Triple Triad: ti spiegherà volentieri le regole di base!

5.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_A1_000_002
5.translation_description: Visualizza la classifica attuale del torneo.

6.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_A1_000_006
6.translation_description: Chiedi informazioni sulla classifica del torneo.

7.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_A1_000_003
7.translation_description: Chiedi informazioni sui premi del torneo.

8.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_A1_000_004
8.translation_description: Chiedi informazioni sulle regole del torneo.

14.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_011_001
14.description: There we are, <hex:022903EB0203>! You are now officially registered for <hex:02281CFF17547269706C655472696164436F6D7065746974696F6EE8020103>. Best of luck in the tournament!
14.translation_description: Ecco fatto, <hex:022903EB0203>! La tua iscrizione a <hex:02281CFF17547269706C655472696164436F6D7065746974696F6EE8020103> è ufficiale. In bocca al lupo per il torneo!

16.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_011_103
16.description: Looking to test your skills against a full field of worthy opponents? Head to the Triple Triad Battlehall and sign up for a tournament! It is as simple as speaking to one of the hall attendants, and stating your desire to enter.
16.translation_description: Vuoi mettere alla prova le tue abilità contro un nutrito gruppo di avversari? Raggiungi la Sala d'Armi di Triple Triad e iscriviti a un torneo! Ti basta parlare con uno degli addetti e dire che vuoi partecipare.

17.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_011_004
17.description: Note that after participating in a tournament, you will be escorted back to Card Square while your ranking is tabulated.
17.translation_description: Dopo aver partecipato a un torneo, verrai riaccompagnato in Piazza delle Carte mentre viene calcolata la classifica.

18.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_011_005
18.description: Furthermore, you will also be escorted out of the Battlehall once it reaches fifteen minutes before the end of the tournament period.
18.translation_description: Inoltre, quando mancheranno quindici minuti alla fine del periodo del torneo, verrai accompagnato fuori dalla Sala d'Armi.

19.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_011_003
19.description: Once the competition is over, speak with the tournament recordkeeper as soon as possible to claim your winnings. A new competition will begin one week after the current tournament ends, and all unclaimed prizes will be forfeit at this time.
19.translation_description: Al termine della competizione, parla subito con il responsabile delle classifiche per ritirare i premi. La nuova competizione inizierà una settimana dopo la fine del torneo in corso; a quel punto, i premi non ritirati andranno persi.

20.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_020_001
20.description: These are the current rankings for <hex:02281CFF17547269706C655472696164436F6D7065746974696F6EE8020103>.

21.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_020_002
21.description: If you are curious where you stand in the ever-heated struggle for first place, you can check your current ranking at any time simply by observing the ranking board in Card Square.
21.translation_description: Se vuoi sapere a che punto sei nell'accesa lotta per il primo posto, puoi controllare la classifica in qualsiasi momento guardando il tabellone in Piazza delle Carte.

22.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_030_000
22.description: Tournament prizes vary from contest to contest, so different winnings will be earned from the Spinner's Pull as opposed to, say, the Durai Memorial.
22.translation_description: I premi cambiano da torneo a torneo: quelli della Pesca della Tessitrice, per esempio, sono diversi da quelli del Memoriale Durai.

23.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_030_001
23.description: Entrants who claim first, second, or third place in <hex:02281CFF17547269706C655472696164436F6D7065746974696F6EE8030103> will be awarded <hex:02310CFF054974656D02E802020203>!
23.translation_description: Chi si classifica al primo, secondo o terzo posto in <hex:02281CFF17547269706C655472696164436F6D7065746974696F6EE8030103> riceverà <hex:02310CFF054974656D02E802020203>!

24.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_030_101
24.description: These top-ranking players will also be awarded a number of MGP, with first place earning a grand prize of <hex:022206E802FF022C03> points!
24.translation_description: I primi classificati riceveranno anche MGP, e chi arriva primo si aggiudicherà il premio di <hex:022206E802FF022C03> punti!

25.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_030_002
25.description: Entrants who place from fourth to sixth in the rankings will be awarded <hex:02310CFF054974656D02E802020203>, as well as a number of MGP dependent on their rank.
25.translation_description: Chi si classifica dal quarto al sesto posto riceverà <hex:02310CFF054974656D02E802020203> e una quantità di MGP in base alla posizione.

26.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_030_007
26.description: Entrants who place from seventh to tenth will be awarded <hex:02310CFF054974656D02E802020203>, as well as─again─a number of MGP based upon their rank.
26.translation_description: Chi si classifica dal settimo al decimo posto riceverà <hex:02310CFF054974656D02E802020203> e, ancora una volta, una quantità di MGP in base alla posizione.

27.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_030_003
27.description: Those who rank eleventh through twentieth will be awarded <hex:02310CFF054974656D02E802020203>, as well as─stop me if you've heard this one─a set amount of MGP based upon their rank.
27.translation_description: Chi si classifica dall'undicesimo al ventesimo posto riceverà <hex:02310CFF054974656D02E802020203> e, sì, lo so, l'ho già detto: una quantità fissa di MGP in base alla posizione.

28.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_030_004
28.description: Lastly, those who fail to place in the top twenty will receive a participation gift of <hex:022206E802FF022C03> MGP.
28.translation_description: Chi non rientra tra i primi venti riceverà un premio di partecipazione di <hex:022206E802FF022C03> MGP.

29.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_030_005
29.description: In addition to these rewards, entrants will receive a bonus amount of MGP based on the number of points they have earned at the conclusion of the tournament.
29.translation_description: Oltre a questi premi, al termine del torneo i partecipanti riceveranno MGP bonus in base ai punti ottenuti.

30.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_030_006
30.description: Entrants who earn enough points will also be awarded a bonus <hex:02310CFF054974656D04E802020203>, so get that tournament score as high as you can!
30.translation_description: I partecipanti che otterranno abbastanza punti riceveranno anche <hex:02310CFF054974656D04E802020203> come bonus: cerca di totalizzare più punti possibile!

31.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_040_001
31.description: Triple Triad tournaments are some of the most enthralling and popular events to be held at the Manderville Gold Saucer!
31.translation_description: I tornei di Triple Triad sono tra gli eventi più avvincenti e popolari del Gold Saucer Manderville!

32.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_040_002
32.description: Once you've entered a tournament, you will be able to play tournament matches against your fellow adventurers in a battle to become the top-ranked player.
32.translation_description: Dopo esserti iscritto, potrai affrontare gli altri avventurieri in partite di torneo per conquistare il primo posto in classifica.

33.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_040_003
33.description: But it won't be easy─the Gold Saucer's champions found here in the Triple Triad Battlehall will also take part in the competition!
33.translation_description: Ma non sarà facile: i campioni del Gold Saucer che trovi nella Sala d'Armi di Triple Triad parteciperanno anche loro!

34.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_040_004
34.description: You should also know that each tournament title has a fixed set of advanced rules that tournament matches must follow!
34.translation_description: Tieni presente che ogni torneo prevede un insieme fisso di regole avanzate, da rispettare in tutte le partite.

35.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_040_005
35.description: Every tournament match you play will count towards your final score. This score will increase for every match you win.
35.translation_description: Ogni partita del torneo contribuirà al punteggio finale, che aumenterà a ogni vittoria.

36.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_040_006
36.description: Oh, and you can only play a set number of matches per tournament, so be sure to make every battle count!
36.translation_description: Inoltre, puoi giocare solo un numero limitato di partite per torneo: assicurati che ogni sfida conti!

38.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_040_008
38.description: Scores will be locked the moment the tournament ends, and these numbers will determine your final ranking.
38.translation_description: I punteggi verranno bloccati non appena terminerà il torneo e determineranno la classifica finale.

39.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_040_009
39.description: Aim to place in the top three and you might just win yourself a rare card!
39.translation_description: Punta a classificarti tra i primi tre: potresti vincere una carta rara!

40.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_040_010
40.description: Participants will be awarded bonus MGP and bonus <hex:02310CFF054974656D04E802030203> based on the number of tournament points they have earned.
40.translation_description: In base ai punti ottenuti nel torneo, i partecipanti riceveranno MGP extra e <hex:02310CFF054974656D04E802030203> in bonus.

41.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_040_011
41.description: The more points you earn, the better the bonus you receive, so try to push your score as high as possible before the tournament comes to a close!
41.translation_description: Più punti ottieni, maggiore sarà il bonus: cerca di totalizzarne il più possibile prima della fine del torneo!

42.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_140_006
42.description: When two or more players share the same score at the end of a tournament, rank is then determined by the greatest number of wins.
42.translation_description: In caso di parità di punteggio al termine del torneo, avrà la posizione migliore chi avrà vinto più partite.

43.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_240_006
43.description: If wins are also equal, then rank will be decided by the least number of matches played. Should match numbers also be equal, then the higher rank will go to the participant who first recorded a result on the tournament ranking board.
43.translation_description: Se anche il numero di vittorie è pari, avrà la posizione migliore chi avrà disputato meno partite. Se persiste la parità, prevarrà chi avrà registrato per primo il proprio risultato sul tabellone della classifica.

44.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_100_001
44.description: <hex:022B22FF2002281CFF17547269706C655472696164436F6D7065746974696F6EE802010303> has come to a close! Let's have a look at the final rankings, shall we?
44.translation_description: Il torneo <hex:022B22FF2002281CFF17547269706C655472696164436F6D7065746974696F6EE802010303> si è concluso! Vediamo la classifica finale?

45.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_110_001
45.description: Congratulations, <hex:022903EB0203>! I see your name right there at number <hex:022206E802FF022C03>!
45.translation_description: Congratulazioni, <hex:022903EB0203>! Sei proprio al posto numero <hex:022206E802FF022C03>!

46.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_110_002
46.description: I am pleased to award you <hex:02310CFF054974656D02E802020203>! And after adding in your point bonus, your total prize winnings come to <hex:022206E803FF022C03> MGP!
46.translation_description: Ecco a te <hex:02310CFF054974656D02E802020203>! Con il bonus per i punti, il totale dei tuoi premi ammonta a <hex:022206E803FF022C03> MGP!

47.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_110_003
47.description: With the addition of your point bonus, I am pleased to award you the sum of <hex:022206E802FF022C03> MGP!
47.translation_description: Con il bonus per i punti, ti assegno volentieri <hex:022206E802FF022C03> MGP!

48.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_110_010
48.description: Your impressive performance has also earned you <hex:02310CFF054974656D02E802020203>!
48.translation_description: La tua ottima prestazione ti ha fatto guadagnare anche <hex:02310CFF054974656D02E802020203>!

52.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_110_004
52.description: Thank you for entering, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>, and I hope to see you return for our next Triple Triad tournament!
52.translation_description: Grazie per aver partecipato, <hex:020817E905FF0A7369676E6F72696E61FF087369676E6F726503>! Spero di rivederti al prossimo torneo di Triple Triad!

53.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_120_001
53.description: ...Ah, I'm afraid you didn't quite earn a winning rank this time around.
53.translation_description: Ah... temo che questa volta la tua posizione in classifica non sia stata sufficiente a vincere.

54.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_120_002
54.description: You are, however, eligible to receive a participation gift of <hex:022206E802FF022C03> MGP...which includes a bonus for your high tournament score!
54.translation_description: Tuttavia, ti spetta un premio di partecipazione di <hex:022206E802FF022C03> MGP... che include anche un bonus per il tuo ottimo punteggio!

55.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_120_005
55.description: You are, however, eligible to receive a participation gift of <hex:022206E802FF022C03> MGP!
55.translation_description: Tuttavia, ti spetta un premio di partecipazione di <hex:022206E802FF022C03> MGP!

56.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_120_010
56.description: Your impressive performance has also earned you <hex:02310CFF054974656D02E802020203>!
56.translation_description: La tua ottima prestazione ti ha fatto guadagnare anche <hex:02310CFF054974656D02E802020203>!

57.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_130_001
57.description: Congratulations on a hard-fought tourney! Should you wish to review the final standings, you may do so at Card Square.
57.translation_description: Complimenti per l'ottimo risultato in un torneo così combattuto! Per consultare la classifica finale, ti basta andare in Piazza delle Carte.

58.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_200_001
58.description: Greetings, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>! Are you looking to enter a Triple Triad tournament? I would be happy to assist in any way I can!
58.translation_description: Salve, <hex:020817E905FF0A7369676E6F72696E61FF087369676E6F726503>! Vuoi iscriverti a un torneo di Triple Triad? Sarò felice di aiutarti!

61.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_A4_000_002
61.translation_description: Chiedi informazioni sulle regole del torneo.

63.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADCUP_00247_TTCUP_210_001
63.description: Our next Triple Triad tournament will be <hex:02281CFF17547269706C655472696164436F6D7065746974696F6EE8030103>! Only the best players will earn themselves <hex:02310CFF054974656D02E802020203>, so have your strongest decks ready!
63.translation_description: Il prossimo torneo di Triple Triad sarà <hex:02281CFF17547269706C655472696164436F6D7065746974696F6EE8030103>! Solo i migliori riusciranno a ottenere <hex:02310CFF054974656D02E802020203>, quindi prepara i tuoi mazzi più forti!
